prompt:
Create a full-bleed 9:16 cinematic dimensional storybook illustration of an open South Indian sandstone temple courtyard bay. Honey-beige aged carved stone, deep brown carved recesses, sunrise from camera-left, ivory and antique gold, orange marigolds, white jasmine and mango leaves, brass lamps and a few incense wisps. Restrained warm bloom, rich atmospheric depth, physically believable columns and changing-camera reflections. The ONLY temple tower visible is one nine-tier sandstone gopuram far behind the board. No little shrine, no small roofed mantap, no Ganesha idol anywhere in this composition: those are outside the image to camera-right. Generate from written description only; no watermark or interface.

SHOT: Eye-level camera in the open courtyard bay immediately to the LEFT of the Ganesha mantap, facing diagonally back toward the same distant nine-tier gopuram. A massive garlanded square column occupies the extreme right foreground, its side face visible to establish an arrival from a LEFTWARD camera orbit. Two rows of carved columns and elephant-shaped stone balustrades recede behind. Center a slightly aged ivory invitation board on a square antique-gold plinth; marigolds and white jasmine form a delicate frame. The board and pedestal together occupy the central lower 52% of the picture, not the entire image. Render exact highly legible ornate gold lettering: 'Bodha’s' / 'Wedding' / 'Invitation', each on its own line. Tiny gold emblem above, restrained flourish below. Brass standing lamps at several depths, small diyas along the floor, realistic warm reflections. Camera left sunlight catches the board edge and foreground pillar. Many white and orange petals flutter in the air at staggered depths, near-lens petal bokeh at the upper edge and tiny golden specks near the floor. An open aisle stretches backward toward the camera and connects to the groom's long pillared hall on camera-right. No people in the foreground. The small Ganesha mantap is offscreen to camera-right and must NOT be drawn in the background. This is a distinct side bay: center the invitation board on its decorated plinth, with only the distant tall tower behind and the side colonnades leading toward it. No small structure between board and tower. Preserve all three exact text lines and the rich airborne petals.
